chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: Positive thinking and faith
summary: He says he has always been lucky, learned faith from his mother, and believes positive thinking brings positive results.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: I have been fortunate all my life. You know, I'm a positive thinker. I always will be lucky.

It works. It really does. You know, I have found it works. Like, I say to my wife sometimes... She may worry about, "Where is this coming from?" I say, "Don't worry, it will happy; it always does." I mean, you don't live this long without knowing that it's always going to happen -- and it does! And that's something I could have possibly learned from my mother. She used to call it faith, and I guess I did, too, until... I know that when you think positive, things will always happen positively for you. If you think negative, it's going to happen negative. True?
Sure. Yeah, you can make your own way with your attitude, I'm sure.
Yeah. Where... Oh, I was talking about the Army. I do jump around. You'd better ask me something.
